Optional custom vendor logos
============================

Put an image here named after the vendor value used in NCM, for example:

    huawei.svg   juniper.png   arista.webp

Supported: .svg .png .webp .jpg .jpeg (square images look best, 64x64 or larger).
NCM shows the image instead of the built-in coloured badge. Refresh the page after adding a file.
Make sure you have the right to use any logo you add.
